<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="pool" name="Organisation" processRef="proc" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="proc" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="lanes">
      <bpmn:lane id="employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>submit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>reviewComments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="supervisor" name="Supervisor">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>review</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>decision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="purchase" name="Purchase Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>quote</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>select</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>valid</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="system" name="System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>register</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>notifyReject</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>notifyChange</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>order</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>receive</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>notifyDone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>endRejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>endCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Office supply needed" />
    <bpmn:task id="submit" name="Submit the office supply request" />
    <bpmn:task id="register" name="Register the request" />
    <bpmn:task id="review" name="Review the request" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="decision" name="Request decision?" />
    <bpmn:task id="notifyReject" name="Send the notification" />
    <bpmn:task id="notifyChange" name="Send the notification" />
    <bpmn:task id="reviewComments" name="Review the comments" />
    <bpmn:subProcess id="quote" name="Make quotations">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="qs" />
      <bpmn:task id="qt" name="Request the quotations from vendors" />
      <bpmn:endEvent id="qe" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="q1" sourceRef="qs" targetRef="qt" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="q2" sourceRef="qt" targetRef="qe" />
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:task id="select" name="Select a vendor" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="valid" name="Vendor valid in the system?" />
    <bpmn:task id="order" name="Generate and send the purchase order" />
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="receive" name="Receive the product and the invoice" />
    <bpmn:task id="notifyDone" name="Send the notification" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endRejected" name="Request rejected" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endCompleted" name="Request completed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="submit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="submit" targetRef="register" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="register" targetRef="review" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="review" targetRef="decision" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" name="rejected" sourceRef="decision" targetRef="notifyReject" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" name="change requested" sourceRef="decision" targetRef="notifyChange" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" name="approved" sourceRef="decision" targetRef="quote" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="notifyReject" targetRef="endRejected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="notifyChange" targetRef="reviewComments" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="reviewComments" targetRef="submit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="quote" targetRef="select" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="select" targetRef="valid" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" name="no" sourceRef="valid" targetRef="select" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f14" name="yes" sourceRef="valid" targetRef="order" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f15" sourceRef="order" targetRef="receive" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f16" sourceRef="receive" targetRef="notifyDone" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f17" sourceRef="notifyDone" targetRef="endCompleted" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
